investigations.summary: GitHub-hosted runners with kernel 6.19+ cannot start mongod (log: 'MongoDB cannot start: Linux kernel versions 6.19 and newer has a known incompatibility', SERVER-121912), so pmm3-client_integration* fail on the unlucky runners while identical jobs pass elsewhere; read in ol10-arm64, ol8-amd64 and GSSAPI ol9-amd64 logs, the 3.9.1 docker upgrade (psmdb primary ECONNREFUSED 27017) is inferred; no VM repro, runner kernel cannot be mimicked and nightly cannot be re-run.

All @ssl-mysql tests passed (test step succeeded); only the 2-second 'Record launchable test results' step failed, a Launchable reporting hiccup, not a product or test defect; not reproduced, not investigated further.

pmm3-upgrade-ami-test-runner asserts the upgraded server reports PMM_SERVER_LATEST, which the orchestrator reads from pmm-submodules v3/VERSION (3.10.1), but the RC image is 3.10.0, so all 5 AMI upgrades fail at 'expected 3.10.1'; fix is in jenkins-pipelines pmm/v3/pmm3-nightly-orchestrator.groovy: pass the RC version (imageTag minus -rc) as PMM_SERVER_LATEST when isRc; no PR opened yet.
